content: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. None has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I keep my covenant and promise to You as best as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favors upon me and I admit my sins. So forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
transliteration: Allaahumma anta rabbee laa ilaaha illa ant, khalaqtanee wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'alaa 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'oodhu bika min sharri maa sana'tu, aboo'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa aboo'u bidhanbee, faghfir lee fa innahu laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba illa ant.
fadl: Known as Sayyidul Istighfar. Whoever recites it with conviction in the morning and dies before evening, or in the evening and dies before morning, enters Paradise.

content: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs all dominion and all praise, and He has power over all things.
transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer.
fadl: Great reward, expiation of sins, and protection from Shaytan. Ten recitations are also reported with virtue.
source: Sahih al-Bukhari 3293; Sahih Muslim 2691; Musnad Ahmad 8719

content: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him.
transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdihi.
fadl: Sins are forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea.

content: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
translation: In the Name of Allah, with whose Name nothing in the earth or the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
transliteration: Bismillaahil-ladhee laa yadurru ma'a ismihi shay'un fil-ardi wa laa fis-samaa'i wa huwas-samee'ul-'aleem.
fadl: Protection from harm during the day and night by Allah's decree.

content: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
translation: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, worldly life, family, and wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from in front of me, behind me, on my right, on my left, and above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being seized from below me.
transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-'aafiyata fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, Allaahumma innee as'alukal-'afwa wal-'aafiyata fee deenee wa dunyaa-ya wa ahlee wa maalee, Allaahumas-tur 'awraatee wa aamin raw'aatee, Allaahummah-faznee min bayni yadayya wa min khalfee wa 'an yameenee wa 'an shimaalee wa min fawqee, wa a'oodhu bi'azamatika an ughtaala min tahtee.
fadl: A comprehensive protection supplication for deen, dunya, family, and safety.

content: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
translation: Say: He is Allah, One. Allah, the Self-Sufficient. He neither begets nor is born. And there is none comparable to Him.
transliteration: Qul huwa Allaahu ahad, Allaahus-samad, lam yalid wa lam yoolad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.
fadl: Part of the three surahs that suffice as protection.

content: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of what He created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow in knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.
transliteration: Qul a'oodhu birabbil-falaq, min sharri maa khalaq, wa min sharri ghaasiqin idhaa waqab, wa min sharrin-naffaathaati fil-'uqad, wa min sharri haasidin idhaa hasad.
fadl: Part of the three surahs that suffice as protection.

content: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers in the hearts of mankind, from among jinn and mankind.
transliteration: Qul a'oodhu birabbin-naas, malikin-naas, ilaahin-naas, min sharril-waswaasil-khannaas, alladhee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin-naas, minal-jinnati wan-naas.
fadl: Part of the three surahs that suffice as protection.

content: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالإِسْلاَمِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.
transliteration: Radeetu billaahi rabban, wa bil-islaami deenan, wa bi-Muhammadin sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallama nabiyyan.
fadl: Allah makes it binding upon Himself to please the one who recites it morning and evening.

content: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَشَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
translation: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and seen, Lord and Sovereign of everything. I testify none has the right to be worshipped except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul, the evil of Shaytan and his traps, and from bringing evil upon myself or causing it to another Muslim.
transliteration: Allaahumma faatiras-samaawaati wal-ard, 'aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadah, rabba kulli shay'in wa maleekah, ash-hadu allaa ilaaha illa ant, a'oodhu bika min sharri nafsee, wa min sharrish-shaytaani wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa 'alaa nafsee soo'an aw ajurrahu ilaa muslim.
fadl: A protection du'a taught by the Prophet to Abu Bakr.

content: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek relief. Rectify all my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
transliteration: Yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoom, bi-rahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha'nee kullah, wa laa takilnee ilaa nafsee tarfata 'ayn.
fadl: A profound supplication of dependence and rectification of all affairs.

content: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahnaa wa bika amsaynaa wa bika nahyaa wa bika namootu wa ilaykan-nushoor.
fadl: Morning remembrance of life, death, and return to Allah.

content: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
translation: We enter the morning and all dominion belongs to Allah. Praise belongs to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs all dominion and praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and what comes after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness, miserable old age, punishment of the Fire, and punishment of the grave.
transliteration: Asbahnaa wa asbahal-mulku lillaah, walhamdu lillaah, laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer. Rabbi as'aluka khayra maa fee haadhal-yawm wa khayra maa ba'dah, wa a'oodhu bika min sharri maa fee haadhal-yawm wa sharri maa ba'dah. Rabbi a'oodhu bika minal-kasal wa soo'il-kibar, Rabbi a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabin fin-naar wa 'adhaabin fil-qabr.
fadl: Comprehensive morning invocation for protection and goodness.

content: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him by the number of His creation, by His pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the ink of His words.
transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdihi, 'adada khalqihi, wa ridaa nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midaada kalimaatih.
fadl: Heavy on the scales and rich in praise of Allah.

content: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الإِسْلاَمِ وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الإِخْلاَصِ وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
translation: We enter the morning upon the natural religion of Islam, the word of sincerity, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the creed of our father Ibrahim, upright and Muslim, and he was not among the polytheists.
transliteration: Asbahnaa 'alaa fitratil-islaam wa 'alaa kalimatil-ikhlaas wa 'alaa deeni nabiyyinaa Muhammadin sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallam wa 'alaa millati abeenaa Ibraaheema haneefan musliman wa maa kaana minal-mushrikeen.
fadl: A declaration of creed and steadfastness at the start of the day.

content: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
translation: Allah is sufficient for me. None has the right to be worshipped except Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
transliteration: Hasbiyallaahu laa ilaaha illa huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu, wa huwa rabbul-'arshil-'adheem.
fadl: Allah suffices the person in concerns and worries.
source: Sunan Abu Dawud 5081 (mawqoof from Abu Darda)

content: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
translation: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return.
transliteration: Allahumma bika amsaynaa wa bika asbahnaa wa bika nahyaa wa bika namootu wa ilaykal-maseer.
fadl: Evening remembrance of life, death, and return to Allah.

content: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
translation: We enter the evening and all dominion belongs to Allah, and praise belongs to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs all dominion and praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and what comes after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness, miserable old age, punishment of the Fire, and punishment of the grave.
transliteration: Amsaynaa wa amsal-mulku lillaah walhamdu lillaah, laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer. Rabbi as'aluka khayra maa fee haadhihil-laylah wa khayra maa ba'dahaa, wa a'oodhu bika min sharri maa fee haadhihil-laylah wa sharri maa ba'dahaa. Rabbi a'oodhu bika minal-kasal wa soo'il-kibar, Rabbi a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabin fin-naar wa 'adhaabin fil-qabr.
fadl: Comprehensive evening invocation for protection and goodness.

content: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He created.
transliteration: A'oodhu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq.
fadl: Recited in the evening, especially when staying in a place, for protection from harm.

content: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ... لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ... فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
translation: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers... Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity... so grant us victory over the disbelieving people. (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:285-286)
transliteration: Aamanar-rasoolu bimaa unzila ilayhi mir-rabbihi wal-mu'minoon... Laa yukallifullaahu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa... fansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen.
fadl: The last two verses of Al-Baqarah suffice the reciter at night as protection.
